Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Winter Leaf")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Nature.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Broad pointed-lobed leaf, olive centre stepping out to ochre and tan-gold edge, no frost or snow, as the card says.

cards.name: Regal Vector Pack 01
cards.summary: Symbol 'Regal Vector Pack 01' from Illustrator's Regal Vector Pack symbol library: a hand-inked ribbon banner that loops and folds in twisting S-curves, drawn with heavy black outlines and fine hatching marks. The ribbon is filled with opaque white (checked on the raw render's alpha), so it covers whatever lies under it. It has no text. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 192 x 263 pt; not a shipped preview.)
use_for: vintage banner and label frames (add text on the ribbon yourself)
avoid: a coloured ribbon: it is black line art; break the link and colour the fills
a labelled banner: the ribbon has no text; add it with the Type tool
a small size: the fine hatching clogs when it is reduced
